name: sf-headless-band
description: Shows your Salesforce default org and the Salesforce MCP servers Claude can reach, with each org's type and scratch org expiry, above the prompt

sharedSandboxes.title: Shared sandboxes
sharedSandboxes.description: My Domain names of sandboxes a whole team shares, the part of the URL before the first dot (acme--uat). Their names show in yellow and their pills carry the shared sandbox label.

sharedSandboxLabel.title: Shared sandbox label
sharedSandboxLabel.description: The words on a shared sandbox's pill.

gates.title: Review gates
gates.description: Commit statuses that stand for a person's step, each as status=words (qa-gate=QA open). The PR line shows the words while the status has not passed and leaves it out of the checks' counts.

sfWrappers.title: Salesforce CLI wrappers
sfWrappers.description: Commands that wrap the Salesforce CLI, by name (sfw). The last target reads their -o and --target-org as it does for sf.
